name: The physician
description: A woman physician whose body Rav briefly possesses to spy on Jacob.

timeline.summary: A physician examines Eloise and speaks oddly to Jacob; later Eloise says she remembers nothing after the merchant's cold hands.
timeline.quote: "I remember . . . the merchant in the tower.
